name: a large animal pretending to be a bed
description: It has the dimensions of a bed and the patience of something much older, and it is definitely warm.
looks: It has been holding this shape for you specifically.
It rises and falls, and the rhythm is not yours yet.
Lying on it would be accepted rather than permitted.
says: You can lie down. I have been waiting.
I do not mind the weight. I have carried worse.
